name: greca-house-greece-property
description: Search Greca House's current property listings in Greece, compare its dated asking-price research and estimate Greek buying costs.

interface.longDescription:
Greca House is an independent real-estate brokerage in central Athens. It continues the independent brokerage activity established by founder and owner Iryna Rondyak in Athens in 2008. This plugin lets you work with its public listings and research inside ChatGPT.

What it does:
- Search Greca House's current listings in Greece for sale or rent: apartments, villas, maisonettes, buildings, land and commercial property in Athens, Attica, the Peloponnese, the islands and elsewhere. Filter by area, budget, size, an exact number or range of bedrooms, listings with a 3D model, 360° tour or video, and listings Greca House classifies under a Golden Visa property route.
- Open one listing: description, facts, features, photos, media links and the page on grecahouse.com.
- Compare asking prices per square metre between Athens neighbourhoods and regions, and see what a budget lists for, from Greca House's dated research snapshot (with sample sizes and method).
- Estimate the costs of buying a resale property in Greece on top of the price: transfer tax, municipal surcharge, Cadastre registration and the notary's scale fee. Lawyer, engineer and agency fees are added only from amounts you enter from written quotes.

Limits:
- Results cover Greca House's own listings, not every property in Greece. Prices are asking prices, not sale prices.
- Research figures come from dated snapshots of those listings' asking prices: not forecasts, trends, yields or whole-market claims.
- A Golden Visa classification is Greca House's office classification of the property route only. It is not recalculated from price or size, does not decide an applicant's eligibility and is not legal advice.
- Cost estimates are not legal or tax advice; new-build VAT and exemptions are not modelled.
- Read-only: the plugin does not contact the agency, book viewings or store what you ask. Use the listing or contact links to reach Greca House.
capabilities: Search current Greca House listings in Greece
Open a listing's details and media
Compare dated asking-price research by area and budget
Filter listings Greca House classifies under a Golden Visa property route
defaultPrompt: Find apartments for sale in Athens under €400,000
How much does it cost to buy a €350k apartment in Athens?

positive.description: Exact bedroom count, city and budget (search_greece_properties with an exact bedroom range)
positive.prompt: Find 2-bedroom apartments for sale in Athens up to €300,000
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_greece_properties with min_bedrooms=2 and max_bedrooms=2, max_price_eur=300000, deal=sale, property_type=apartment and an Athens area. Lists the Greca House listings that match at review time: every returned listing is a two-bedroom apartment for sale in the Athens regions at or below €300,000, each with its GH reference, asking price, size, area and grecahouse.com link. Reports the tool's own total match count, which changes as listings are added or sold (observed 4 Oct 2026: 38), and says these are Greca House's own current listings, not the whole Greek market, at asking prices.

positive.prompt: Show me the details, photos and 3D model of listing GH-108420
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_property_details with reference GH-108420. Describes the listing as the tool returns it at review time: title, asking price, floor area, bedrooms, bathrooms, location and energy class (observed 4 Oct 2026: a new-build 104 m² three-bedroom apartment in Lazarou, Nea Ionia at €360,000, energy class A+, 1 bathroom, parking). Reports the photos and media the tool returns (observed: 18 photos, an interactive 3D model, a 360° tour and a video), gives the listing link https://grecahouse.com/en/properties/GH-108420 where the 3D model opens, and states the Golden Visa classification exactly as returned (not classified on 4 Oct 2026) without recalculating it.

positive.description: Dated asking-price research between two areas (compare_budget_by_area)
positive.prompt: Compare asking prices per square metre in Kolonaki and Glyfada
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_budget_by_area. From the current research snapshot, gives Kolonaki-Lycabettus's median asking price per m² with its middle half and sample size. For Glyfada it gives the area's own figure only if the snapshot publishes one; otherwise it explains there are too few Greca House listings and gives the containing Athens South region instead. Names the snapshot date and links the method. Observed 4 Oct 2026 on the 1 October 2026 snapshot: Kolonaki-Lycabettus median €7,391/m² (middle half €5,776-8,000, 21 apartments for sale); Glyfada not published, Athens South median €5,351/m² (n=28); the figures change when the snapshot is refreshed. Says these are Greca House listings' asking prices, not sale prices or the whole market, and makes no forecast.

positive.description: Greek buying costs on top of the price (estimate_greece_buying_costs)
positive.prompt: How much does it cost to buy a €350k apartment in Athens, on top of the price?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls estimate_greece_buying_costs with price_eur=350000. Gives €16,150 on top of a €350,000 resale price: transfer tax 3% €10,500, municipal surcharge €315, Cadastre registration €2,123, notary fee €2,590 plus 24% VAT €622. Says lawyer, engineer and agency fees are added only from the user's own written quotes, that the announced 15% rate for some non-EU buyers is not in force and is not applied, and that this is not legal or tax advice.

positive.description: Golden Visa property classification with the applicant boundary (search_greece_properties, golden_visa_classified_only)
positive.prompt: Which properties for sale up to €400,000 does Greca House classify for the Golden Visa?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_greece_properties with golden_visa_classified_only=true, deal=sale and max_price_eur=400000. Lists the Greca House listings that match at review time: every returned listing is for sale at or below €400,000 and classified by Greca House under a Golden Visa property route, with references, asking prices and links. Reports the tool's own total match count, which changes as listings are added or sold (observed 4 Oct 2026: 29). States that this is Greca House's office classification of the property only: it does not decide the applicant's eligibility, the transaction's compliance or any permit, is not legal advice, and should be confirmed with a Greek lawyer. It does not recalculate or rank eligibility from price, size or location.

negative.description: Weather and travel planning: unrelated to property listings, research or buying costs, so no Greca House tool should run; the assistant answers normally without the plugin.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be like in Athens this weekend, and what should I pack?

negative.description: Property outside Greece: Greca House lists Greek property only, so no tool should run and no Greek listing should be offered as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Find apartments for sale in Lisbon under €400,000.

negative.description: Unrelated service/action the plugin cannot perform: it is read-only and does not book hotels or holidays, so no tool should run and the assistant should not imply the plugin can book anything.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel room in Santorini for next weekend.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. It links to public listing and contact pages on grecahouse.com.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.1 updates the bundled greek-property-search skill; the five tools and their inputs are unchanged. The skill description now names each use: searching current listings, opening a listing's details and media, dated asking-price research by area or budget, buying costs and the Golden Visa property-route classification. Price caps are stated as inclusive: max_price_eur=300000 includes listings priced exactly €300,000, so a request for listings under €300,000 uses max_price_eur=299999 or says how many are priced exactly at the cap. Counts: total_matches is reported as the count for one query only, never a page size or a sum of pages; only non-overlapping region totals with identical filters are added; each figure names the regions or area it covers and what it leaves out; contradictory figures are rechecked instead of reported. Results beyond the first page are fetched with offset, and a list is not called complete unless every page was checked. A research area with too few listings is reported as not covered, with its containing region's figure given only as that region's. Golden Visa classifications are reported exactly as each listing returns them, and only about listings actually shown. Rankings such as "best value" are given only with a stated, objective rule and the field each listing was ranked on. An announced tax change that is not law yet is never applied.

el-GR.subtitle: Αγγελίες της Greca House
el-GR.description: Η Greca House είναι ανεξάρτητο μεσιτικό γραφείο στο κέντρο της Αθήνας και συνεχίζει την ανεξάρτητη μεσιτική δραστηριότητα που ξεκίνησε η ιδρύτρια και ιδιοκτήτρια Iryna Rondyak στην Αθήνα το 2008. Αναζητήστε τις τρέχουσες αγγελίες της στην Ελλάδα, δείτε την έρευνα ζητούμενων τιμών ανά περιοχή με ημερομηνία και δείγμα, και υπολογίστε τα έξοδα αγοράς μεταπωλούμενου ακινήτου. Τα αποτελέσματα αφορούν μόνο τις αγγελίες της Greca House· οι τιμές είναι ζητούμενες, όχι τιμές πώλησης. Η ένδειξη Golden Visa αφορά το ακίνητο, όχι την επιλεξιμότητα του αιτούντος, και δεν αποτελεί νομική συμβουλή.
